text:
ben: Heads up — rack60/node03 (gpu03) is generating periodic PCIe bus resets and AER spikes. Seen as short NVLink link flaps and Xid 31s, causing embed-pool latency >2x. Pls triage.

ben: Logs excerpt:
```
[ 1234.567890] pcieport 0000:03:00.0: AER: uncorrected error: tx err
[ 1234.567895] pcieport 0000:03:00.0: PCIe Bus Error: severity=Uncorr, type=Transaction Layer
[ 1234.567900] nvidia 0000:03:00.0: nvlink: lane 2 down, link flapping
[ 1234.567905] Xid (31): GPU fault: Single bit ECC? ECC counters incremented: 412 -> 429
```

priya: Is this one card or multiple cards on the node?

ben: Looks like a single card (gpu03) on node rack60-03; other GPUs on node are stable. AER counts map to that PF.

dave: OK. Immediate steps: cordon + drain that node from embed-pool, then move critical pods. Use soft-evict for long jobs.

dave: `kubectl cordon rack60-03`
dave: `kubectl drain rack60-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300`

lina: Run quick telemetry check before hardware ops: `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,LINK,PCI` and `dmesg | grep -i nvlink` — want exact ECC/Xid counts and any kernel stack traces.

ben: Pasted nvidia-smi ECC section — delta since last boot: single-digit increments but Xid spikes line up with bus resets.
```
GPU 3 ECC Errors: 412 -> 431 (corrected)
NVLINK Link Errors (lane 2): 12 events in last 10m
PCIe AER counter: Uncorr=3, Corr=27
```

priya: Sounds like flaky PCIe lane or riser. If draining doesn't stop the flaps when we repro, we'll move toward RMA for the card+slot. Prioritize avoiding rolling restarts across us-west embed capacity.

dave: Capacity note — embed-pool is at 82% reserved this week. If we pull one node out, latency SLAs might degrade. Suggest temporarily scaling up a reserve pool in us-west-2 (ephemeral on-demand) to soak traffic while we RMA. That costs ~1.3k/day but keeps customer QoS.

ben: Agree. I'll open a request to spin 2 g4/reserve nodes for 6-12 hours.

sre-oncall-bot: Incident created: INF-2026-1284 — "rack60-03 pcie/nvlink intermittent link flaps". Pager duty notified.

lina: If RMA is slow, we can try swapping the card into spare slot on the same node to see if errors travel with card or slot. Steps: power down node -> swap -> boot -> monitor. Prefer doing this in maintenance window.

priya: Also consider forcing model routing away from that node via placement constraints so we don't over-evict. Add a 10m placement weight penalty.

dave: Action items: 1) ben to cordon+drain (in progress). 2) ben to request 2 reserve nodes. 3) lina to collect full `dmesg` + `lspci -vvv` + attach to hardware ticket. 4) if errors persist after drain+reboot, open RMA for gpu03 and the riser.

ben: Started drain, ETA ~6m. Reserve nodes request submitted. I'll update this thread with telemetry and RMA id. :thumbsup:

priya: Thanks — keep it tight. If latency crosses 2.5x for >10m we trigger customer-notify playbook.

ben: noted. updating status now.
